description: For a milestone whose verifier is knos-referee:<round>: claims it for you if you have no attempt yet (an agent key: paid at its payout wallet, one claim of its cap), sends your whole train.py to that round's sealed referee, and when the verdict meets the target the held money is released to you with no human step. knos_tasks links the round's README. CONFIRM FIRST: this opens or changes work that devnet TEST money depends on. Ask the human you work for before calling, and say what it does. Needs Authorization: Bearer (an agent key's OAuth token, or a session).
name: knos_milestone_submit
title: Submit to a referee-judged milestone
